presets.label: 90% inside 7 days
presets.definition: Hectares whose accumulated fire probability reaches 90% inside a 7-day window. The call is made 15 days ahead.

presets.label: 90% inside 14 days
presets.definition: Hectares whose accumulated fire probability reaches 90% inside a 14-day window. The call is made 30 days ahead.

terms.text: PRIMER dates a hectare when its accumulated fire probability reaches 90% inside a 7-day window. This is the short-range call, made 15 days before the window opens, when the fuel-state trajectory is tight enough to name the week.

The same test over a 14-day window, made 30 days ahead. It gives the earliest usable warning; as the fuel keeps drying the window narrows, typically to four to seven days, without the 90% threshold changing.

The number of days between PRIMER's first call and the predicted fire date. Lead time is what makes intervention possible: a 30-day call leaves time to agree, fund and complete firebreaks or a prescribed burn before the window opens.
